what: The Aura of a Genesis changes what its signature does: fifty signatures (five shapes by ten effects), checked in one online match.
build_status_detail: Genesis roster: 1969 heroes, 3 of 3 roles with a character, 50 of 50 signatures authored, ruleset genesis-0.3.0.
method: One online match in headless Chrome through the LAN address (one idle human, five bots, specials charged at spawn), 80 s. Skill uses and damage events counted from the CHOG_COMBAT console lines.

effects.burn: 70% damage, then 300 per second for 3 s
effects.mend: 80% damage, caster healed 700 per enemy touched
effects.purify: 90% damage, target loses 2 of its attack energy
effects.rally: 85% damage, caster deals 35% more for 4 s
effects.veil: 90% damage, target loses half of its special charge
effects.toxin: 50% damage, then 220 per second for 5 s

reading: 2200, 1800 and 2600 are the raw beam, wave and flash.
1260 is the burning wave (70% of 1800) and the two events of 300 are its burn.
1700 is the rally nova (85% of 2000); 632 is an arrow of 468 fired during the rally bonus (468 x 1.35), which shows the bonus applies to the caster's other attacks.
No error and no missing asset in the console.
tests: python3 tools/quantum/headless.py test: 30 catalog checks and 19 Quantum tests pass; the signature test now checks that the same Eyes with another Aura give another special and that token 1795 reads 'brute / flash / purify'.
limits: Only raw, burn and rally appeared in this run, by the luck of which Genesis the bots were; chill, hex, mend, purify, haste, veil and toxin use the same mechanism but were not observed.
The on-target feedback (burst in the Aura colour, lasting fire, stars or bubbles) and the tint of the attacks were not seen: the automated browser is too slow to capture them.
Whether a burn that finishes a target gives the kill to its caster was not checked.
The numbers are a first pass, not a balance: no kit budget, and the delivery of each Tier is still not applied.
The lobbed shot of the puddle was reported hard to see by the user; cause not found yet.
